q: Corrie ten Boom yali ani olutalo nga terunnatuuka, era Beje kyali ki?
a: Mu bulamu bwe obusinga yali muddaabiriza wa ssaawa mu Haarlem, omukazi atali mufumbo eyabeeranga waggulu w'edduuka lya famire mu nnyumba enfunda ba ten Boom gye baayita Beje, ng'amanya baagaggya mu luguudo kwe yali, Barteljorisstraat. Kitaawe, Casper, naye yali muddaabiriza wa ssaawa, omusajja eyatya Katonda era omuwombeefu ow'enzikiriza ey'Ekidatchi Ekirongooseddwa, era mwannyina Betsie ye yali munne obulamu bwe bwonna. Gaali maka ga bulijjo, agakkiriza, ag'engeri etereeta mawulire okumala emyaka amakumi ataano, era Corrie yali kumpi n'emyaka amakumi ataano ebintu bwe byabaawo ensi kaakano by'emujjukirirako.

q: Kituufu nti ye yali omukazi eyasooka okuweebwa layisinsi ey'okuddaabiriza essaawa mu Netherlands?
a: Bw'etyo eyeekaalu erabirira ennyumba ye bw'ewandiika. Yayiga omulimu gwa kitaawe mu dduuka lya famire, era mu myaka gya 1920 (mu 1924, ng'ebiwandiiko by'eyeekaalu bwe biraga; ensibuko endala zigamba 1921 oba 1922) n'afuuka omukazi omusooka okuweebwa layisinsi ey'okuddaabiriza essaawa mu Netherlands. Mu kitundu ekisinga eky'obulamu bwe ogwo gwe gwali olugero lwe lwonna: omukazi atali mufumbo, edduuka lya famire, ekkanisa, n'omulimu omuvuvu ogw'ebyuma ebitono.

q: Famire ya ten Boom yatuuka etya okukweka Abayudaaya mu kiseera ky'okuwambibwa?
a: Germany yawamba Netherlands mu 1940, era okuyigganyizibwa kw'Abayudaaya Abadatchi bwe kweyongera, ba ten Boom ne bayingizibwa mu mukutu ogw'ekyama. Ennyumba yaabwe enkadde eri wakati mu kibuga, ejjudde ensonda ez'enjawulo, yafuuka ennyingo mu lujegere olwatambuza Abayudaaya n'abakozi ab'okuziyiza omulabe okutuuka mu bukuumi. Ekisenge eky'ekyama kyazimbibwa emabega w'ekisenge eky'obulimba mu kisenge kya Corrie yennyini eky'okwebaka ku ddaala erya waggulu, ekifo ekitono ennyo abantu abatono mwe basobola okuyimirira. Eyeekaalu erabirira ennyumba leero egamba nti famire n'omukutu gwaabwe baayamba okununula abantu abagerageranyizibwa okuba lunaana, abasinga obungi ku bo nga tebaakwekebwa mu nnyumba yennyini wabula mu bifo ebirala eby'obukuumi, nga bateekebwa omu ku omu, obulamu bwa buli muntu mu nnyumba nga buli mu kabi.

q: Kiki ekyabaawo famire bwe yaliibwamu olukwe?
a: Nga 28 February 1944 omukessi Omudaaki yabaliiramu olukwe. Ennyumba yagwaako amagye era abantu nga amakumi asatu ne bakwatibwa ku lunaku olwo, Corrie ne Betsie ne kitaabwe omukadde nga bali mu bo. Abaserikale tebaazuula kisenge kya kyama: abantu omukaaga abaali beekwese emabega w'ekisenge, Abayudaaya bana n'abakozi ab'okuziyiza omulabe babiri, baasigala eyo, nga basirise, okumala ennaku bbiri n'ekitundu, okutuusa abapoliisi abaabasaasira lwe baabaggyayo. Ekifo eky'okwekweka kyanywera; abo abaakizimba tebaanywera. Era si bonna be kyakweka nti baawonawo olutalo: Mary van Itallie yakwatibwa nate mu nnaku ntono ng'ali mu kifo ekirala, n'afiira e Auschwitz nga 1 May 1944, so nga Meijer Mossel, omukulembeze w'ennyimba mu kkuŋŋaaniro ab'omu nnyumba gwe baayitanga Eusie, yawangaala n'alaba okununulibwa.

q: Kitaawe ne mwannyina Betsie baatuuka ku ki?
a: Kitaawe, Casper, eyali mu myaka gy'amakumi munaana, yafa nga wayiseewo ennaku nga kkumi oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa. Corrie ne Betsie baayisibwa mu kkomera ery'e Scheveningen n'olusiisira olw'e Vught, oluvannyuma ne batwalibwa ebuvanjuba mu Germany, mu lusiisira olw'abakazi olw'okusibirwamu olw'e Ravensbrück. Betsie, omunafu era omulwadde, yafiirayo nga 16 December 1944. Nga tannafa yagamba Corrie, emirundi n'emirundi, nti kibagwanira okufuluma oluvannyuma ne babuulira abantu kye baayiga, era ekigambo ekisinga okukwataganyizibwa ne bannyinaze ababiri kyali kikye: "Tewali bunnya bwa buziba nnyo Ye gy'atabeera wansi n'okusingawo."

Corrie ategeeza mu The Hiding Place (1971) nti ennyumba yaabwe ey'omu lusiisira eyajjula abantu yali ejjudde obunyama, era nti Betsie yanywerera ku kwebaza Katonda ne ku bwo. Corrie yali tasobola kulaba makulu gaakyo, naye n'awa okwebaza wadde bwe kityo. Oluvannyuma lwokka lwe baategeera: abakuumi tebaayagala kuyingira mu kisenge ekijjudde obunyama, bwe kityo bannyinaze ababiri ne balekebwa bokka okusomera abakazi abalala Bayibuli mu ddoboozi, awatali kuziyizibwa, mu kifo ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo mwe kyali kitasoboka. Mu nsonda emu ey'olusiisira olwo abakuumi gye beewalanga, bannyinaze ababiri baasomera abaali basaliddwa okufa Ekyawandiikibwa.

q: Corrie yawonawo atya so nga bangi tebaawonawo?
a: Ku nkomerero ddala ya December 1944, nga wayiseewo ennaku ntono okuva Betsie lwe yafa, Corrie n'ata, olw'ensonga ezitannyonnyolwangako mu bujjuvu. Ekiwandiiko kye ekisooka, ekyawandiikibwa mu 1945, kiraga nti bannyinaze ababiri baali basuubira ekiseera ky'okusibibwa ekigere okuggwaako; emyaka bwe gyayitawo yabuulirwa nti kyava ku nsobi ey'omuwandiisi, era mu The Hiding Place ategeeza nti abakazi ab'omu mulembe gwe baatwalibwa okuttibwa nga wayiseewo akaseera katono ng'amaze okuvaayo. Ka kibe nti kyava ku ki, mu wiiki ntono olusiisira ne lutandika okutta abalwadde n'abakadde ne ggaasi. Teyeewaana nti yali yeefunidde okuwona wadde nti akitegeera bulungi. Yali ayingidde ne mwannyina ne famire n'afuluma bwannamunigina, ng'atutte ekiragiro okuva eri omukazi eyafa okugenda okubuulira kye baayiga.

q: Okusisinkana n'akuumi ow'e Ravensbrück kwali kutya, era lwaki kujjukirwa?
a: Okumala emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lw'olutalo Corrie yatambula mu nsi yonna ng'ayogera ku kusonyiwa n'okutabaganya. Awo, nga bw'akitegeeza yennyini, mu 1947, mu kkanisa mu Munich, omusajja yajja mu maaso ng'amaze okwogera, ng'amwenyumwenya, ng'agolodde omukono gwe, n'amutegeera nga yali akuumi e Ravensbrück. Yamugamba nti kati yali afuuse Omukristaayo era n'amubuuza obanga yandimusonyiye. N'ayimirira ng'akwatiddwa, nga tasobola kuyimusa mukono gwe, era n'asaba mu kasirise nti: "Yesu, sisobola kumusonyiwa. Mpa okusonyiwa Kwo." Awo n'akwata omukono gwe ng'ekikolwa eky'okwesalirawo, era, nga bw'ategeeza, ebbugumu lye yamanya nti si lirye ne liyita mu mukono gwe ne liyingira mu mikono gyabwe egyakwatagana. Isomo yalyogera mu bwerufu: "Okusonyiwa kikolwa kya kwesalirawo, era okwesalirawo kusobola okukola nga tekufaayo ku bbugumu ly'omutima."

q: Kiki kye yaleka emabega, era obulamu bwe bwakoma butya?
a: Mu 1967 Yad Vashem yamukkiriza ng'omu ku Batuukirivu mu Mawanga olw'omulimu gwa famire ogw'okukweka Abayudaaya. Mu 1971 yategeeza olugero lwonna mu The Hiding Place, olwawandiikibwa ne John ne Elizabeth Sherrill, era firimu n'eggoberera mu 1975; byombi byafuula omuddaabiriza wa ssaawa Omudaaki ne mwannyina eyafa okumanyibwa mu nsi yonna. Yafiira mu Placentia, California, nga 15 April 1983 — ku lunaku lwe olw'amazaalibwa ag'omulundi ogw'ekyenda mu gumu, olunaku lwe lumu lwe yazaalirwako. Ky'aleka kigambo kimu ekyagezesebwa, ekyaggyibwa mu kifo ekyazimbibwa okukizikiriza: nti okusonyiwa si kuwulira kw'olindirira wabula kintu ky'okola, era nti bw'okikola n'omutima omunnyogovu n'emikono emyereere, okwagala okugijjuza kuweebwa.
